metadata.source: OpenLandMap Soil Texture Class, USDA system (ISRIC World Soil Information / OpenLandMap project), via Google Earth Engine -- a global statistical soil map, NOT an India-specific ground survey (Soil Health Card / ICAR-NBSS&LUP have no public bulk API as of 2026-10-21 -- see scripts/config.py's header above for what was checked and rejected).
metadata.resolution: 250 m native pixel, surface (0cm) depth band
metadata.band: b0 (0cm depth) of SOL_TEXTURE-CLASS_USDA-TT_M/v02 -- the asset also carries b10/b30/b60/b100/b200 (deeper soil layers), not used here; this pipeline reports surface texture only, matching what a farmer standing in the field would judge by hand.
metadata.method: Per district/block/village polygon: ee.Reducer.mode() over the real raster pixels inside that polygon (the dominant texture class by pixel count -- a categorical class cannot be averaged, so mode, not mean, is the only honest reducer). Village/block tiers computed in ONE batched ee.Image.reduceRegions() call per district over that district's whole village FeatureCollection, not one GEE call per village.
metadata.block_tier_note: Not computed this pass -- honest gap, not derived/guessed from the village data below.
